content.content:
Apply by reading the dependent and its two prerequisites as recorded; there is nothing to run.
1. License, once per prerequisite in depends_on. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite it names. Read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from.
2. Non-encroachment. The dependent settles nothing beyond this use, and nothing the prerequisites place elsewhere: what a refusal says, on what stream and with what exit status; what becomes of a discarded draft's record, of its workspace and directory, and of the change that workspace holds; whether the call writes a node or a change or is one of the operations; the help text; and the line discipline of rendered normal output. Fail on any element that settles one of these, naming the element and the commitment it duplicates.
3. Applicability. Fail when the dependent carries no requirement content — empty or placeholder content; an absent elaboration is not a silent pass.

Findings name the offending element. Nothing is named in advance, so rewording the dependent without changing what it decides leaves this criterion intact.
content.rationale: Discard silence is where the discard surface meets the output rule: the surface fixes which calls are answered with a discard and defers what a success writes, and the output rule constrains only the output a verb renders — so the gate checks that the dependent's statement of silence contradicts neither and adds nothing to what either leaves elsewhere. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (kxyznwxu, natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (svxynnwk, structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix. One evaluation covers both edges because silence is one question asked of both: the call it is silent about and the channel it is silent on. The applicability limb keeps a placeholder from passing vacuously.
